decision.rule: Pre-tax no_tax_roi is primary and tax-adjusted ROI secondary; same-window historical positives are descriptive and require strict independent EV plus held-out/forward validation; no purchase, production, betting or promotion authority.

saturation_rule: nominal_M is a reporting label; effective_M=min(nominal_M,3^N) controls actual draw count and stake; FULL_SPACE_SATURATED nominal rows share one allocation per identity/seed/effective_M and are not extra WR tickets.
scope: historical paper-only research; no purchase, production, betting or promotion authority
settlement_rule: Hit iff the frozen truth code is among the effective_M distinct Q-WOR tickets; gross=¥2×0.65×product(trusted final winning SP) exactly once on hit.
tax_rule: 20% is applied per individual winning ¥2 ticket iff that ticket gross >= ¥10,000; no issue/policy pooling or aggregation.
unit: complete lottery issue; native pool is provenance only
